The user says "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker service, you need to start the Docker Desktop or the Docker Engine service. On Windows, you can use `net start com.docker.service` or `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service` in PowerShell. Or if using Docker Desktop, you can launch the Docker Desktop application.

But the user might want to start Docker engine via command line. We can use `docker-machine start default` if using Docker Machine. Or `sc start com.docker.service`. Or `Start-Service com.docker.service`.
